title: Governance
learning_outcomes: Explain governance versus management in the context of governance.
Compare and distinguish oversight in the context of governance.
Apply conflicts of interest in the context of governance.
Evaluate and justify decisions about reporting in the context of governance.

lessons.title: Governance versus management
lessons.outcome: Explain governance versus management in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving governance versus management; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional board charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain governance versus management from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of governance versus management; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Oversight
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish oversight in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving oversight; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional board charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain oversight from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of oversight; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Conflicts of interest
lessons.outcome: Apply conflicts of interest in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving conflicts of interest; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional board charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain conflicts of interest from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of conflicts of interest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reporting
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about reporting in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reporting; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional board charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reporting from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reporting; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of governance versus management; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of oversight; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of conflicts of interest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reporting; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
